reward.failure_rule: first physical violation or safe-no-actuation command and every remaining internal sample
reward.invalid_rollout: reject complete update; retain attempt and remaining unopened population

warning_definition.target: first physical violation or safe-no-actuation in the next 30 commands
warning_definition.leave: 30 consecutive supported scores strictly below exit_threshold

provider_definition.early_trigger: explicit scheduled intervention; not a prediction
provider_definition.warning_trigger: first frozen natural withdrawal request, including unsupported observations
provider_definition.handoff: one irreversible episode-local latch; no reentry in this diagnostic
provider_definition.selected_handoff: unchanged selected actor, slew from actual preceding correction and issued history
provider_definition.baseline_handoff: unchanged v1 uncertain refusal; immediate zero residual
provider_definition.unsupported: original unsupported refusal to deterministic baseline, including after selected handoff
provider_definition.warning_after_handoff: retain shadow prediction; never return control to the challenge actor

pair_comparison.post_handoff: fresh causal trajectories; no equality requirement
pair_comparison.fresh_baseline_regression: all 1440 controller rows and 7200 trace rows match retained reach hold per group
